# Mnémophage — proposition visuelle v1

Illustration de fiction produite avec l’outil intégré image_gen. Vue subjective d’une exploration mentale : les scènes superposées sont des souvenirs reliés, pas des passages spatiaux.

[Image](mnemophage-v1.png)

## Prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a cinematic painterly fantasy bestiary illustration of a MNEMOPHAGE, an original instinctive non-living creature perceived during exploration of human memory. Main scene is a remembered medieval rainy courtyard beneath a timber awning. A wet dark wool cloak hangs prominently from a peg, water dripping, textured old stone and wood. Beneath the awning, main subject is a compact nonhumanoid animal core with long finely branching organic limbs folded into nested loops. Its dark pearly pliable skin has delicate warm ivory branching tips, no brain-shaped mass, no human face, no giant eyes, no robot, no sinister grin. A few limbs physically contact remembered details: one grips a fold of the wet cloak, another touches a drip on the stone. One longer branching limb follows an associative path into a DIFFERENT MEMORY visible through a softly overlapping region at the edge of the courtyard: a flood-swollen river and partly submerged medieval street. A third thinner branching tip begins to reach toward a separate dim remembered view of an ordinary traveler walking through rain on a country road, suggesting contact with the observing mentalist's own memory. These are subjective MEMORY SCENES, not real spatial portals: use subtle painterly double exposure and continuous rain motifs, no glowing doorways, no sci-fi holographic panels. Keep one coherent central creature sharply legible with full knotted body and distinctive looped branching anatomy, main courtyard anchors visually grounded, secondary memories understated. No diagram arrows, no labels, no readable writing. Mood intimate, uncanny, beautiful complexity, a strange neutral animal following sensory associations. Slate blue rainy light, warm brown wood, tactile organic material, soft amber highlights on branching tips, high-end cinematic fantasy painting with realistic surfaces. Landscape composition. No gore, no watermark. Proposed visual interpretation of a creature within mental exploration, not physical proof of a body in the courtyard.
